in_marathi.name: Baadal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baadal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'baadh', which means 'to pour'. The name Baadal refers to the clouds or the sky. In Hindu mythology, Baadal is also the name of a god associated with rain and clouds.
